mechanism: Propylthiouracil can cause agranulocytosis and immunosuppression, increasing infection risk and potentially impairing potassium regulation; additionally, both agents may affect cardiac conduction and potassium homeostasis in thyroid dysfunction states.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; assess for signs of infection or hematologic abnormalities; ensure adequate renal function and adjust potassium supplementation based on clinical status and lab values.
